business_summary.text: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Limited develops, operates, and manages port infrastructure and special economic zones.

company_name: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Limited

auditor_history.name: M S K A & Associates LLP

guidance.statement: FY27 revenue is expected to be in the range of ₹43,000 Cr to ₹45,000 Cr.
FY27 EBITDA is expected to be in the range of ₹25,000 Cr to ₹26,000 Cr.
FY31 revenue is expected to reach ₹91,500 Cr at a 19% CAGR.
FY31 EBITDA is expected to reach ₹52,000 Cr at an 18% CAGR.

entities.name: Jaypee Uttar Bharat Vikas Private Limited

industry: Services > Transport Infrastructure > Port & Port services

operating_notes.text: Scheme of Amalgamation of wholly owned subsidiary Adani Harbour Services Limited with Adani Ports became effective on April 21, 2026.
APSEZ handled 500.8 MMT of cargo in FY26.
APSEZ announced Ambition 2031 targeting ₹91,500 Cr revenue, ₹52,000 Cr EBITDA, and total 5-year capex of ₹90,000 - 100,000 Cr.
APSEZ handled 43.1 MMT of total cargo in April 2026, up 15% YoY, led by 17% growth in containers and dry cargo, while logistics rail volume stood at 48,490 TEUs (-16% YoY).
APSEZ marine arm Astro Offshore contracted with Oceaneering International for European subsea expansion and added the Astro Atlas vessel.
Meridian Transportes Marítimos S.A. holds a 10-year contract with Southern Energy S.A. for supply of six vessels, executed December 22, 2025.
Adani Ports signed an SPA to acquire 100% of Jaypee Fertilizers & Industries Limited for ₹1,500 Cr, gaining ~243 acres of land in Kanpur.
Step-down subsidiary Astro Middle East Ship Management DMCC incorporated Astro Ship Management Angola (SU) LDA with USD 10,000 capital.
FY26 related-party transactions were ₹14,687.78 Cr, about 38% of revenue, with income from operations with other entities at ₹6,232.30 Cr.
FY26 finance costs rose 65.5% to ₹4,653.98 Cr while revenue grew 24.6%.
FY26 contingent liabilities were ₹975.81 Cr, about 1% of net worth.
Secured 10-year marine services contract for Argentina's first LNG export project via a 51:49 JV with Meridian Group.
Incorporated Indian Ocean Gateway Terminal in the Sultanate of Oman as a wholly owned step-down subsidiary with a share capital of OMR 5,00,000.

holders.name: Goldman Sachs Trust Ii - Goldman Sachs Gqg Partners International Opportunities Fund

timeline.summary: Adani Ports completed the amalgamation of wholly owned subsidiary Adani Harbour Services Limited, effective April 21, 2026.
Adani Ports reported a 15% YoY increase in total cargo volumes to 43.1 MMT for April 2026, driven by growth in container and dry cargo.
APSEZ's marine arm Astro Offshore contracted with Oceaneering International for European subsea expansion and added an ultra-deepwater support vessel.
Adani Ports' step-down subsidiary The Adani Harbour International FZCO signed an SPA on May 15, 2026 to buy 51% of Argentina's Meridian Transportes Marítimos S.A. for USD 444.49 in cash.
Adani Ports signed a share purchase agreement to acquire 100% of Jaypee Fertilizers & Industries Limited for ₹1,500 Cr, securing ~243 acres of land in Kanpur.
S.B. Adani Family Trust (via **Pritamkumar Pritamkumar Nenmal Shah**) declared no new encumbrances on Adani Ports’ shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026.
On May 21, 2026, Adani Ports announced the incorporation of Astro Ship Management Angola as a step-down wholly owned subsidiary.
Adani Ports filed its FY26 Integrated Annual Report on 29 May 2026, showing an unmodified audit opinion, related-party transactions of ₹14,687.78 Cr and contingent liabilities of ₹975.81 Cr.
Adani Ports reported a 16% YoY increase in cargo volume to 48.3 MMT for May 2026.
On June 5, 2026, Adani Ports announced that its step-down subsidiary The Adani Harbour International FZCO incorporated Harbour International Shipping FZCO in the UAE.
Adani Ports secured a 10-year marine services contract for Argentina's first LNG export project on June 8, 2026.
2026-08-03: Adani Ports released the transcript of the earnings call for Q1FY27 results
On 22 October 2026, Adani Ports announced the incorporation of Indian Ocean Gateway Terminal as a wholly owned step-down subsidiary in Oman.
